notes: Cash basis, governmental funds only (no business-type funds). Statement of Activities (p2) and governmental funds statement (p4) both roll fund balance / net position 16,223,407 to 17,577,116; beginning cash not printed, ending cash = Cash 17,577,116 (p3). Other taxes 1,531,032 split by fund name as in FY2023: Inheritance Tax Fund 827,440 (p20) is inheritance tax; the rest (Central Comm. 78,352 + Other Nonmajor Funds 625,240) stays other taxes. 'Local fees, licenses, commissions, and miscellaneous' kept as one line (licenses and permits per the user's label decision, as FY2023) with review; Statement of Activities charges for services 6,073,371 + miscellaneous local 937,934 = 7,011,305. Detail: General Fund receipts and transfers from the budget schedule (p5-6; transfers in has a budget but no actual, omitted); General Fund disbursements from the departmental Schedule of Disbursements (p14-19, more detailed; function-level lines on p5-6 not recorded); Road and Bridge, Self-Insured Medical Insurance, COVID ARP, Detention and Capital Improvement budget schedules (p7-11). Nonmajor funds: receipts and transfers per fund column from the combining schedule (p20; 5 columns), so the combined nonmajor budget schedule's receipt and transfer lines (p12-13) are not recorded; nonmajor disbursements from the nonmajor budget schedule (p12-13, function x object), since the combining schedule prints disbursements by object only with no function (combining disbursement lines not recorded, no double counting). Keno Fund 'Local fees...' 576,843 is keno/lottery by fund name (user ruling 2026-11-12); its Intergovernmental 46,323 kept as intergovernmental. Lines with a budget but no actual are omitted. COVID ARP, Self-Insured and Capital Improvement single receipt lines have no printed totals. Veterans Service Officer printed under the Public Works heading; Handi-bus and Motorbank under Public Welfare and Social Services. Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement (p3; equals the government-wide Statement of Net Position 17,577,116 on p1, which prints Restricted 7,703,264 and Unrestricted 9,873,852).
